title: Minimum-Earned Charge: Share Kept by Time in Force
content:
Under the Physical Damage Coverage (Comprehensive and Collision), the time-in-force share of the minimum-earned charge on a coverage return depends on how long the coverage has been in force. The days in force are counted in calendar days from the coverage effective date to today, with today counted and the effective date not.

| Days in force | Time-in-force share of the minimum-earned charge |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 90 | One (the whole charge) |
| At least 90 but fewer than 180 | One half |
| 180 or more | Zero |

**Boundary pairs (hypothetical):**
- 89 days in force keeps the whole charge. 90 days keeps one half.
- 179 days keeps one half. 180 days keeps none.
